issues.what: Each micro-preview opens on a near-white flash: more than 60% of the tag region is above luma 200 at f1232, 1276, 1324 and 1362. That is four near-white frames in 130 f, which fights the deep-black grade. Each tag then types on over about 16 f instead of slamming on its word (1238→1254, 1282→1294, 1330→1346), so it is complete about 15–19 f after the word. The third tag, 'What actually erases a file', is fully readable only from f1346 to f1360 (about 15 f) and is gone at f1364, about 36 f before its sentence ends ('…gone for good'@1388).
issues.fix: Slam each tag in whole on its word ('work'@1235, 'fail'@1279, 'erases'@1327). Keep the third preview, or at least its tag, up until the exit push at about f1375. Replace the white flashes with whip or zoom-through cuts, or cap each flash at about 50% luma for 2 f.

issues.what: In the signature image, the lifted card's top edge sits at y=11 half-px at f430 and y=2 at f460 (22 px, then 4 px, at 1080p). That is well inside the 64 px safe margin, so the card hugs the frame top while the 0.5 px/f push continues. The hero composition reads top-heavy and cramped next to the 'Gone.' ghost.
issues.fix: Lower the 'signature' pose (or the push target) so the card's top stays at 32 half-px or more (64 px) through f471, for example by starting about 30 half-px lower or pushing toward the threads and wall instead of upward.
